contract.goal: An editable PowerPoint for {{audience}} where every figure, date and quote on a slide is cited to the supplied source or a source the crew researched, and appears in it.

deliverables.description: The finished PowerPoint, one slide per H1 of its Markdown source

criteria.text: The deck is saved as a real PowerPoint file
The deck's Markdown source holds its slides, split on H1 headings
The supplied source was opened and read; with only a topic, sources were researched when the device allows it
Load-bearing figures and claims carry (source: path) citations, and every cited file exists
Every number, date and quote on a slide appears in the source it cites; nothing checkable is stated that no source shows
It opens with context, makes one argument slide by slide, and closes with the ask or next step

judge.rubric: Does the deck open with context, make one clear argument with one message per slide, and close with the ask or next step for its audience?
